authority_contract.source_relation_records: all and only fit synonym and lexical_head_sibling_contrast records from the SHA-bound compositional v2 JSON
authority_contract.query_lookup: exact string identity resolved once by the CPU authority producer
authority_contract.synonym_indices: left indices into the frozen primary object bank and right indices into the frozen synonym component
authority_contract.sibling_indices: left and right indices into the frozen primary object bank

synonym.target: teacher left-minus-right response gap and teacher left-minus-right canonical-negative relevance gap on every canonical source region
synonym.student: the same two gaps from the student descriptor
synonym.reduction: equal mean of response-gap SmoothL1 and relevance-gap SmoothL1
synonym.purpose: teacher-calibrated synonym consistency without assuming exact equality of two text embeddings

sibling.target: teacher left-minus-right canonical-negative relevance gap on the same canonical source region
sibling.direction_balance: equal mean of left-dominant and right-dominant weighted means when both exist; one available direction otherwise
sibling.purpose: fine-grained sibling specificity without target labels

relation_type_weights.normalization: normalize across the two relation types to equal effective relation-type weight

loss_contract.combination: existing V2.1 auxiliary plus 0.25 times typed_relation_loss; exact previous V2.1 behavior when no relation authority is supplied
